name: universal-referee-analytics
description: 🏆 Universal Sports Analytics platform for real-time match logging across Soccer, Basketball, and Football. Engineered with Python, Docker, and Pandas to showcase scalable DevOps and Cloud-readiness.

paragraphs: A containerized full-stack web application designed for sports officials to log and visualize match events in real-time. This tool supports multiple sports with weighted scoring systems (Soccer, Basketball, Football) and provides instant data analytics.
features: Multi-Sport Support: Dynamic event tracking for Soccer (Goals/Cards), Basketball (2pt/3pt/Fouls), and Football (Touchdowns/Sacks).
Weighted Scoring Logic: Engineered a point-mapping system to ensure score accuracy (e.g., Basketball 3-pointers vs. Soccer Goals).
Match Lifecycle Management: Integrated "Reset" functionality to clear existing data and start new sessions instantly.
Interactive Dashboard: Built with Streamlit for a responsive, dark-mode user interface.
Containerized Deployment: Fully dockerized to ensure environment parity and cloud-readiness.
